tasks.title: Mulch around peach tree
tasks.description: Apply 3-4" of mulch around the drip line to retain moisture and suppress weeds. Keep mulch 6" away from trunk to prevent rot.

subtasks.title: Clear existing weeds around drip line
Ensure 6" gap between mulch and trunk

tasks.title: Clear brush around fence lines
tasks.description: Remove overgrown brush along all fence lines to maintain access, prevent fence damage, and reduce fire risk.

subtasks.title: Dispose of brush (burn pile or haul off)

tasks.title: Clean out garage
tasks.description: Full cleanout — sort items into keep, donate, trash. Prerequisite for all finish work.

tasks.title: Clean out workshop
tasks.description: Organize and clean workshop space. Clear workbenches and floor.

tasks.title: Finish interior of garage
tasks.description: Complete interior finish work — drywall, paint, trim. Blocked by cleanout.

tasks.title: Run new power to garage
tasks.description: Run dedicated circuit or subpanel to support mini split, tools, and future EV charging. Do before mini split install.

tasks.title: Install mini split in garage
tasks.description: Install ductless mini split for heating and cooling the garage/workshop. Requires new power circuit first.

tasks.title: Run new power to kitchen
tasks.description: Kitchen needs dedicated circuits: 2x 20A for countertops, 20A for dishwasher, 40-50A for range. Do before cabinets and appliances.

tasks.title: Install kitchen cabinets
tasks.description: Full kitchen cabinet installation. Measure carefully — order lead time can be 4-8 weeks. Depends on power rough-in.

subtasks.title: Measure kitchen and create cabinet layout
Mark studs and install ledger board

tasks.title: Install appliances
tasks.description: Install range, dishwasher, refrigerator, and hood. Depends on cabinets and power circuits being done.

tasks.title: Finish floors
tasks.description: Install finished flooring throughout remaining areas. Do after walls are complete to avoid damage.

subtasks.title: Measure and calculate square footage per room

tasks.title: Finish utility room
tasks.description: Complete utility room — drywall, paint, shelving, and verify all utility connections.

subtasks.title: Verify water, gas, and electric connections

tasks.title: Fix sink fixtures in bathroom
tasks.description: Replace or repair bathroom sink faucet, handles, and drain fixtures.

subtasks.title: Turn water back on and test for leaks

tasks.title: Build local AI machine (Axios)
tasks.description: Dedicated AI inference machine with NVIDIA GPU. Will run Ollama, ChromaDB, and ComfyUI — serving as the RAG/embedding backend for the farm network via farmstead.

subtasks.title: Finalize parts list (CPU, GPU, RAM, NVMe)
Install NVIDIA drivers and container toolkit
Point Open-WebUI on farmstead to Axios Ollama
Test RAG pipeline with wiki documents

tasks.title: Build microATX machine for pinball cabinet
tasks.description: Small form factor PC to power a virtual pinball cabinet with Visual Pinball X and PinballY front-end.

subtasks.title: Source parts (GPU for DMD + playfield output)

tasks.title: Rebuild Mountain Dew arcade cabinet
tasks.description: Full restoration — new monitor, reconditioned cabinet exterior, fresh MAME/RetroPie install with proper artwork.

subtasks.title: Install Raspberry Pi or PC for MAME
Source or print replacement artwork and bezel

tasks.title: Setup Retro CRT open frame arcade
tasks.description: Open-frame arcade setup using a CRT TV with MiSTer FPGA or Pi for authentic scanline output.

subtasks.title: Build or source open frame stand
Choose platform (MiSTer FPGA vs Pi vs PC)

tasks.title: Setup capture card and VCR for digitization
tasks.description: Set up capture workflow using a capture card and VCR. Prerequisite for VHS conversion project.

subtasks.title: Source or verify capture card (analog input)
Test VCR playback quality — clean heads if needed
Install and configure OBS or VirtualDub2
Test capture with a sample tape
Define output format and storage path on farmstead

tasks.title: Convert VHS tapes to digital
tasks.description: Capture and archive all VHS tapes. Store on farmstead or external. Blocked by capture card setup.

subtasks.title: Catalog all tapes (label, content, estimated condition)
Store original tapes in protective cases

tasks.title: Test solar battery with ESP32
tasks.description: Prototype a solar-charged ESP32 node. Goal: prove out solar + battery for wireless farm sensors. Log data back to farmstead via MQTT.

subtasks.title: Gather components (ESP32, TP4056, LiPo or 18650, small solar panel)
Wire solar panel → charge controller → battery → ESP32
Write firmware to measure and report voltage + uptime
Deploy outside and test over 24-48 hours
Send data to farmstead via MQTT → n8n

tasks.title: Get LoRa device and test with solar light kit
tasks.description: First step toward a farm-wide sensor network. Test LoRa range and solar power viability across the property.

subtasks.title: Order LoRa module (TTGO LoRa32 or Heltec WiFi LoRa 32)
Wire to solar light kit as power source
Set up LoRa gateway or second receiver node
Document range results and plan sensor payload
